questions.question: What did the White House say about reimbursing taxpayers for more than $10 million already spent on Trump’s “Patriotic Ads”?
options: The government would recover the money through tariffs
Microsoft would reimburse the government
MAGA Inc. had already repaid the full amount
Trump’s payment plan applied only to ads moving forward
questions.explanation: The White House clarified that MAGA Inc. did not plan to reimburse past spending and would pay only for ads moving forward. Trump said, “We’ll decide,” when asked about repayment.

questions.question: What policy did Michigan Republican Senate nominee Mike Rogers call on Trump to end?
options: Federal support for Michigan’s auto industry
The naval blockade of Iranian oil exports
The “tariff war” with Canada
The H-1B visa program
questions.explanation: Rogers called for an end to Trump’s “tariff war” with Canada, saying Michigan residents know that Canada is not their enemy.

questions.question: How many Medicare beneficiaries were slated to receive one-time $90 payments to help offset Part B premiums?
options: About 1 million
About 20.8 million
About 6 million
About 12 million
questions.explanation: Trump planned to send $90 to 20.8 million Medicare beneficiaries using money from the Medicare Improvement Fund.

questions.question: What did Trump say would remain “in full force and effect” even though he ruled out attacking Iran before the midterms?
options: The U.S. naval blockade of Iranian oil exports
The removal of B-1 bombers from Britain
The tariffs on Canadian goods
The suspension of technology firms from the H-1B program
questions.explanation: Trump said the naval blockade of Iranian oil exports would continue while the United States sent another aircraft carrier and thousands of troops to the region.

questions.question: How much did Trump’s tariffs add to consumer goods inflation at their estimated peak?
options: 1.8 percentage points
0.9 percentage points
2.9 percentage points
5 percentage points
questions.explanation: The tariffs added an estimated 2.9 percentage points to consumer goods inflation during the 12 months ending in February 2026.

questions.question: What happened hours after the administration suspended Microsoft from using the H-1B visa program?
options: Microsoft withdrew all of its visa applications
JD Vance apologized for accusing Microsoft of fraud
The administration reinstated Microsoft in the visa program
Trump awarded Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella the National Medal of Technology and Innovation
questions.explanation: Trump awarded Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella the National Medal of Technology and Innovation hours after the company’s H-1B suspension. Nadella once held an H-1B visa himself.

questions.question: Which Supreme Court justice decided against retiring because he believed he could still make “a valuable contribution”?
options: Brett Kavanaugh
Samuel Alito
John Roberts
Clarence Thomas
questions.explanation: Samuel Alito said he considered retiring but decided to remain on the Supreme Court because he could still make “a valuable contribution.”

questions.question: What did California Gov. Gavin Newsom do after Trump suggested letting Iran “take out” Los Angeles and San Diego?
options: He directed the state’s threat assessment center to monitor foreign actors
He asked Congress to end the war with Iran
He closed California’s ports to Iranian cargo
He ordered the California National Guard to deploy overseas
questions.explanation: Newsom called the remarks “deranged and dangerous” and directed California’s threat assessment center to watch for foreign actors interpreting them as an invitation to attack.
